requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep repository-native build test runtime binary assets in the repository
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Storage Boundary explicitly keeps source-controlled binary assets in the repository when they are required for build, test, runtime, deployment or the product itself.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: store documentary PDF and PPTX artifacts in the documented Drive project folder when no other authoritative external source exists
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Drive-Artifact Gate and the Drive Artifact Contract classify documentary and distributive PDF/PPTX outputs for the canonical Drive project folder when no other authoritative external location exists.

requiredBehaviors.evidence: Umgang mit kanonischen Artefakten requires Project Memory to reference repository-native and external canonical artifacts while keeping only links, status, IDs and concise evidence in the memory layer.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: move build test or runtime assets to Drive merely because they are binary
